steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to RFQ.
Apply the RFQ template that supplies the pricing sheet and delivery-date requirement.
Verify that the RFQ template was applied.
Add the requested CYLINDER line item with quantity 10.
Set the line item's delivery location.
Complete the required pricing-sheet fields so the only missing prerequisite is the delivery date.
Commit the event schedule while retaining the blank delivery date.
Reopen the schedule drawer to verify and retain the empty Delivery Date field.
Confirm that the schedule drawer is open.
Explicitly leave the required Delivery Date empty.
Save the schedule without entering a delivery date.
Attempt publication and assert that Procol refuses it with the delivery-date validation message.
